test_match.explanation: M14 needs repeated tiny foot-contact tolerance plus supported camera and uncertainty <=2.5m; sparse/mistaken observations and broad player boxes do not establish contact. Image apparent diameter alone does not certify zero height.

validation.protocol: Past-only accepted M8 image warps align history, constant last warp extrapolated to future; unsupported chains fall back to CV. No future images/GT used for forecasting. Diagnostic comparison, no post-TEST selection.

test.protocol: Past-only accepted M8 image warps align history, constant last warp extrapolated to future; unsupported chains fall back to CV. No future images/GT used for forecasting. Diagnostic comparison, no post-TEST selection.

limitations: Original organizer ball GT lacks independent visibility/height/metric labels; manual demo audit is source-only Codex annotation, not external adjudication.
Detection evaluator inherits an unavailable-sharpness default bucket: blur strata are NOT measured; do not interpret that bucket as blur truth.
Tracking center consistency uses12px, distinct from detector IoU.25. Adjacent samples are correlated.
No reliable learned ground classifier, surveyed metric references or predicted pitch coordinates; supported metric frames0.
No learned discrete motion-state classifier; image velocity/direction-change diagnostics only.
No demonstration of improved overall detection; lower predicted-error rate comes with less observed/predicted coverage.
